title: Payload — verification.claim_revoked
$comment: Must carry the same author as the claim it revokes: a verifier retracts its own word. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
